# SSD Sentinel

> Free, open-source (MIT) SSD & HDD health monitor, SMART diagnostics, Win32 IOCP Direct-I/O disk benchmark, deterministic LBA surface scanner, SHA-256 NTFS tiering manager, and strictly read-only NTFS forensic file recovery suite for Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64).

- [Latest Windows Release](https://github.com/yuefdev/ssd-sentinel/releases/latest) provides the NSIS installer, portable ZIP, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- Tech Stack: Rust + Tauri 2 + TypeScript + Win32/NTFS Kernel APIs + bundled `smartmontools 7.5` (`smartctl.exe`, GNU GPL-2.0-or-later)
- Safety Model: Default Read-Only Guard (`read_only_guard = true` on fresh installs), structured Dry-Run Execution Manifest with deterministic IPC confirmation tokens, zero hidden telemetry, zero AI/ML models, SLSA Build Provenance attestations, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` verification.

## Website Pages

- [Home — SSD Sentinel Free SSD Health Monitor](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/): Overview, core features, screenshots, and verified release download.
- [SSD Sentinel vs CrystalDiskInfo](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/crystaldiskinfo-alternative/): Honest open-source comparison with CrystalDiskInfo.
- [Free Hard Disk Sentinel Alternative](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/hard-disk-sentinel-alternative/): Feature-by-feature comparison with Hard Disk Sentinel.
- [How to Check SSD Health on Windows 10 & 11](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/ssd-health-check/): Step-by-step SMART, PowerShell, and physical warning-sign guide.
- [How to Check NVMe SSD Lifespan & TBW](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/nvme-lifespan/): Interpreting NVMe Percentage Used, Available Spare, and 720-sample endurance forecasts.
- [Free SSD Benchmark Tool (Win32 IOCP Direct-I/O)](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/benchmark/): Unbuffered Direct-I/O throughput, IOPS, latency, and PCIe/SATA link bottleneck detection.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://yuefdev.github.io/ssd-sentinel/faq/): Answers on safety, SmartScreen unsigned notices, Read-Only Guard, licensing, and Snapshot Replay Mode.
